{'text': 'The Observatory forecasts that today\'s maximum outdoor temperature will be 34 degrees, close to the 34.9 degrees recorded on the "hottest Da Shu" in 2022, and about 4 degrees higher than last year\'s "Da Shu".'}

{'text': 'The Observatory has issued the Very Hot Weather Warning, forecasting that today will be mostly fine, but with showers in some areas from morning to noon, and the daytime temperature will be very hot. Separately, a subtropical ridge is bringing sunny weather to Hong Kong, but coastal areas will also be affected by showers.'}

{'text': 'The Hong Kong Observatory has issued the Very Hot Weather Warning, forecasting that today will be mostly fine, but with showers in some areas from morning to noon, and the daytime temperature will be very hot. In addition, a subtropical ridge is bringing fine weather to Hong Kong, but coastal areas will also be affected by showers.'}

{'text': 'Looking back at past Da Shu periods, the highest temperature recorded was 34.9 degrees in 2022, while the lowest was 22.2 degrees in 1965.'}

{'text': 'In addition, during past Da Shu periods, the highest average relative humidity and the highest total rainfall both occurred in 1994, at 96% and 195.1 millimetres respectively; while the lowest average relative humidity was 70% in 1968.'}
